question.text: A Portfolio Manager wants to protect a Rs. 100 crore equity portfolio using put options. She buys protective puts at the money for a total premium of Rs. 3 crore. If the market falls 15% by expiry, what is the approximate net P&L on the combined portfolio + put position?

explanation.text: The Logic: Portfolio loss = 100 × 15% = Rs. 15 cr. Put gain at the same ITM amount = Rs. 15 cr. Net before premium = 0. Less premium paid Rs. 3 cr → Net loss = Rs. 3 cr (= premium). The Trap: Full 15% loss ignores hedge; 'zero' ignores the premium cost; Rs. 12 cr is a partial miscalculation. Cross-Exam Context: VIII treats option payoffs; XXI-B layers portfolio framing.
